source_title: Civilization #42: The Protestant Reformation and the Birth of Capitalism
summary: This March 2025 Protestant-anxiety lecture is already-public support for Power, Attention Capture, and Mass Society: Protestant direct access and double predestination generate anxiety, money becomes the proof-symbol that carries God and reality, and mass society makes exit from capitalist discipline politically ugly.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Money resolves Protestant anxiety by becoming the symbol that can prove grace, stand in for God, and finally feel like reality itself.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Power As Alchemy page already uses this source as the religious-origin layer for money as a shared symbol that converts God, proof, judgment, and reality into a measurable object.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Double predestination turns doubt into danger, so anxiety is answered by work, money-making, accumulation, and the same disconnection that later feeds suicide.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Attention Capture page already uses this source for the older religious form of anxiety returning attention to work before later capital turns that anxiety into extraction energy.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Weber's capitalism/theocracy choice is narrowed further by mass society: millions or billions must be fed, organized, occupied, and made meaningful.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Mass Society page already uses this source as a defining layer for population scale narrowing the political exit from capitalism, theocracy, or state control.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Mass society makes political options limited because the system must feed, organize, and occupy millions.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The atlas-level Mass Society anchor already cites this source for the same scale constraint.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the older religious-origin layer for money as alchemical proof. Protestant anxiety requires a visible sign of grace; money becomes that sign, then becomes the symbol that standardizes judgment and reshapes reality.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power owns the conversion layer where money carries God, proof, judgment, and reality. Attention owns the anxiety and focus discipline; Mass Society owns the population-scale trap; Religion As Administrative Filter owns church mediation and operator-selection codes.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the religious prehistory of capital's attention technology. Double predestination makes self-confidence a duty, anxiety becomes work compulsion, accumulation becomes reassurance, and disconnection becomes the hidden cost.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Attention owns captured focus, anxiety, and nervous-system discipline. Power owns money as the shared object; Mass Society owns the scale constraint; Human Heart and Free Will own damaged relation or agency only when those are the active mechanisms.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the page's Protestant-anxiety entry point. The lecture starts with religious liberation, moves through money and the iron cage, then asks what political options remain when billions must be fed, organized, occupied, and made meaningful.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Mass Society owns the scale test for capitalism, theocracy, state control, and political exit. Eschatology owns sacred role-script only when the future theocracy is carried by end-times sequencing; Prediction owns dated forecast status only after branch splitting.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only as bounded comparison pressure if Administrative Filter later needs the Reformation's mediation problem: Catholic orthodoxy, hierarchy, and works become disconnection, while Protestant direct access shifts proof of faith from priestly office to literacy, interior certainty, work, and money.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Administrative Filter owns mediation, office, discipline, and trust codes. This source's active public pressure is money-proof, attention anxiety, and mass-society constraint rather than a new Reformation page.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the theocratic-return claim as forecast-family routing pressure only. Jiang says capitalism's disconnection can make theocracy feel like a natural response, but this source does not by itself justify a standalone Theocracy, New Prophets, or Zombie Civilization page.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology receives this only when a later source turns theocratic return into sacred role-script or end-times choreography. Mass Society owns the scale problem; Attention owns anxiety/disconnection; Prediction owns dated forecast splitting.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold zombie civilization and specialists-without-spirit as Dead World comparison pressure only when a future compression needs late-capitalist dead ontology: the lecture says modernity can become life without soul, spirituality, heart, or purpose.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Dead World owns dead ontology when the mechanism is life drained of soul and meaning. This impact pass should not reopen Dead World immediately after the Paradiso compression.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-03-27, this lecture supplies an older religious genealogy for mechanisms that later capital lectures treat in economic terms: anxiety becomes work, money becomes proof/reality, and population scale makes exit from the system difficult.

The source explicitly marks the money solution as developing over decades or centuries, then anchors the historical sequence in Luther's 1517 theses, the 1530s-1648 Reformation wars, Calvin's predestination, the Huguenot loss to France, and circa 1900 sociological diagnosis.

The theocratic-return and new-prophet material is a dated 2025 classroom forecast family, not a ledger-ready claim: split zombie society, new prophets, theocracy, anti-capitalist revolt, mass-society scale, and disconnection before any public forecast mutation.

next_actions.action: No immediate public prose mutation is needed: Power As Alchemy, Attention Capture, Mass Society, and the atlas already cite this source and preserve stable anchors for money proving grace, anxiety returning attention to work, and mass society narrowing political freedom.

Do not create standalone Protestant Anxiety, Iron Cage, Reformation Capitalism, Money Is God, Zombie Civilization, New Prophets, Theocracy, Weber, Simmel, Durkheim, Calvin, Luther, Huguenots, Thirty Years War, Printing Press, Musket, or Banknote pages from this source alone.

If future synthesis follows, prefer a concept-cluster review comparing Protestant anxiety, Dutch middle-class anxiety, Tocqueville's American status anxiety, and Capital of Evil's destroyed-security mechanism before adding more ordinary prose to Attention Capture.

If forecast work follows, split the theocracy-return branch across Mass Society, Eschatology, Nation, and Prediction before scoring; this source supplies a broad causal model, not a verified event claim.
